title: Comparison of microhardness, surface roughness, retain-->Candida albicans adhesion, and color stability among TiO₂-coated and uncoated conventional, milled, and 3D printed denture base materials
html: Studies investigating the effect of the titanium dioxide (TiO2) coating on the microhardness, surface roughness, Candida albicans (C albicans) adhesion, and color change of conventionally manufactured, milled, and printed denture bases are lacking.
